title: Configuring the Sentinel Platform: Roles, Data Tiers, Workbooks and SOC Optimization

header.html: 1. Manage a security operations environment (40 to 45%)

Specify Microsoft Sentinel roles; manage data retention for XDR and Microsoft Sentinel tables, including Analytics, Data lake and XDR tiers; create and configure Microsoft Sentinel workbooks; optimize the Microsoft Sentinel platform, including SOC optimization recommendations
the official Microsoft SC-200 study guide (skills measured as of October 21, 2026) and Microsoft Learn

html:
1Sentinel roles

Role What it can do
Microsoft Sentinel Reader View data, incidents and workbooks
Microsoft Sentinel Responder Reader plus manage incidents (assign, change status, tags, comments)
Microsoft Sentinel Contributor Responder plus install and update solutions and create or edit rules and other resources
Microsoft Sentinel Playbook Operator List, view and run playbooks manually
Microsoft Sentinel Automation Contributor Lets Sentinel add playbooks to automation rules; not for users
Workbook Reader / Workbook Contributor View or create workbooks
Fact Detail
Create or edit analytics rules or workbooks Contributor, or Responder or Reader plus Workbook Contributor
Manage the Content hub Contributor at resource group level
Best scope Resource group level; at workspace scope you also need the roles on the SecurityInsights solution resource
Guest users who assign incidents Responder plus the Entra role Directory Reader
Assignments Cumulative
Exam tip

. Reader sees, Responder works incidents, Contributor builds content. Pick the lowest role that does the job, at resource group scope.

Data lake roles (Microsoft Entra): read = Global reader, Security reader, Security operator, Security administrator, Global administrator; write, KQL jobs and notebooks = Security operator, Security administrator, Global administrator.

2The three data tiers

Tier Purpose Retention
Analytics Interactive, hot; all real-time features (analytics rules, hunting, workbooks, playbooks) Analytics retention 30 days to 2 years (extra cost); total retention up to 12 years
Data lake Low-cost storage for large, rarely queried data 30 days to 12 years; the data is stored only in the lake
XDR default tier Defender XDR tables (for example advanced hunting tables) 30 days, free; extending to 90 days costs only ingestion

Analytics data is mirrored to the data lake for the same period by default (one copy of data). Included analytics retention differs by page (90 days for Sentinel tables, 30 days for XDR tables, with some pages showing 30 days as the base) [Verify live].

Capability Analytics tier Data lake tier
Analytics rules, hunting queries, workbooks, playbooks, watchlists, parsers Yes No
Full KQL with joins and unions, scheduled KQL jobs, notebooks Yes Yes
Search jobs and summary rules Yes Yes
Restore and data export Yes No
Exam tip

. Cheap, long, rarely queried = Data lake. Detections and workbooks = Analytics. Changing a table from Analytics to Data lake stops its analytics rules, alerting and hunting.

3Setting retention

Step Detail
Path Microsoft Sentinel > Configuration > Tables, select the table, Manage table, Save
View tables Security data basics (read)
Change tier or retention Data (manage); Azure equivalent Log Analytics Contributor (plus Sentinel Contributor)
Lowering total retention Data stays for 30 more days before removal
Changing analytics retention Takes effect immediately

KQL jobs (Module 17) and notebooks promote data from the lake to the Analytics tier when a detection needs it.

4Workbooks

Workbooks are Azure Monitor workbooks: each is an Azure resource with RBAC. They turn Sentinel data into interactive dashboards.

Task Detail
Template Threat management > Workbooks > Templates; check Required data types, then Save (saves a JSON Azure resource)
Edit View saved workbook > Edit > Done Editing
New Add workbook; data source Logs; resource type Log Analytics
Roles Workbook Reader or Workbook Contributor on the resource group; creating or deleting needs Sentinel Contributor (or lesser) plus Workbook Contributor
Save as Clones a workbook into My workbooks; templates cannot be deleted; deleting a workbook is permanent
Auto refresh 5 minutes to 1 day; off by default

Useful workbooks: Incident Overview, Investigation Insights, MITRE ATT&CK, Security Operations Efficiency, Data collection health monitoring, Analytics Health & Audit, Workspace Usage Report, Threat Intelligence, Azure Activity.

Exam tip

. Data collection health monitoring shows ingestion problems; Security Operations Efficiency shows SOC metrics such as time to triage and close.

5SOC optimization

SOC optimization gives recommendations to get more security value from your data and detections. Path: Defender portal > SOC optimization (Azure portal: Threat management > SOC optimization).

Category Types
Coverage Threat-based, AI MITRE ATT&CK, risk-based
Data value Move or remove low-value data (for example change a table to a Basic plan)
Fact Detail
Threat-based coverage rating High above 75% of recommended rules active; Medium 30 to 74%; Low 0 to 29%
Refresh Every 24 hours
Status Active (default), In progress, Complete (auto-completes when no longer relevant), Dismissed; Reactivate from the Completed or Dismissed tabs (up to one hour)
Actions Go to Content hub (add analytics rules), Change plan (move a table to Basic logs), View threat scenario in MITRE ATT&CK
Exam tip

. A coverage recommendation is answered by adding rules from the Content hub; a data value recommendation by changing the table plan.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1An engineer must install solutions from the Content hub and edit analytics rules, with the least privilege. Which role and scope should be assigned?

  • AMicrosoft Sentinel Reader at the subscription level
  • BMicrosoft Sentinel Responder at the workspace level
  • CGlobal Administrator at the Microsoft Entra tenant level of access
  • DMicrosoft Sentinel Contributor at the resource group level
Show the answer

Answer: D. Contributor can install solutions and create or edit rules; the resource group is the recommended scope.

S2Firewall logs must be kept for seven years for audit, are rarely queried and must be stored at the lowest cost. What should be configured for the table?

  • AAnalytics tier with an analytics retention of two years
  • BXDR default tier with the retention extended to 90 days
  • CData lake tier with a retention of seven years
  • DBasic logs, with the table linked to a workbook
Show the answer

Answer: C. The Data lake tier is low cost and keeps data up to 12 years.

S3A table is moved from the Analytics tier to the Data lake tier. Which capability stops working for that table?

  • AAnalytics rules, alerting and hunting queries
  • BScheduled KQL jobs against the table
  • CFull KQL queries with joins in the lake
  • DNotebook analysis of the table
Show the answer

Answer: A. Analytics rules, alerting and hunting need the Analytics tier.

S4An analyst needs to view the tables and their tiers in the Defender portal but must not change them. Which permission fits?

  • AData (manage) in the data operations permission group
  • BLog Analytics Contributor on the workspace
  • CSecurity data basics (read) in security operations
  • DMicrosoft Sentinel Contributor on the resource group
Show the answer

Answer: C. Viewing tables needs Security data basics (read); changing them needs Data (manage).

S5A user needs to create and delete workbooks. The user already has Microsoft Sentinel Reader. What else is needed?

  • AMicrosoft Sentinel Playbook Operator on the resource group
  • BWorkbook Reader on the resource group of the workspace
  • CLogic App Contributor on the resource group of the playbooks
  • DWorkbook Contributor on the resource group of the workspace
Show the answer

Answer: D. Creating or deleting workbooks needs Workbook Contributor.

S6SOC optimization shows a threat-based coverage recommendation for ransomware with missing detections. Which action adds the missing rules?

  • AChange plan so the tables move to the Basic logs plan
  • BDismiss the recommendation and run a KQL job instead
  • CExport the recommendation to a workbook for later review by the team
  • DGo to Content hub and install the recommended solution rules
Show the answer

Answer: D. Coverage recommendations link to the Content hub to add analytics rules.

6.2 Recall questions

R1Which role can manage incidents but not install solutions?

Show the answer

Microsoft Sentinel Responder.

R2What is the maximum total retention?

Show the answer

12 years.

R3How long is free retention for XDR tables?

Show the answer

30 days.

R4Where do you set table retention?

Show the answer

Microsoft Sentinel > Configuration > Tables > Manage table.

R5How often do SOC optimization recommendations refresh?

Show the answer

Every 24 hours.

R6What is the range of workbook auto refresh?

Show the answer

5 minutes to 1 day (off by default).

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Roles Reader sees, Responder manages incidents, Contributor builds; resource group scope
Tiers Analytics (all features), Data lake (cheap, up to 12 years), XDR (30 days free)
Move to lake analytics rules, hunting and workbooks stop
Retention path Configuration > Tables > Manage table
Workbooks Azure Monitor resources; Workbook Contributor to create
SOC optimization coverage (Content hub) and data value (change plan); refresh 24 hours
